theory.intro: AWS Secrets Manager Rotation Exploitation is a core security discipline in AWS cloud operations.

sections.heading: Understanding AWS Secrets Manager Rotation Exploitation
sections.content: In modern cloud environments, proper configuration of AWS Secrets Manager Rotation Exploitation ensures privilege boundaries and access controls prevent unauthorized resource manipulation.

sections.heading: Security Risks & Attack Vectors
sections.content: Misconfigurations related to AWS Secrets Manager Rotation Exploitation allow attackers to perform unauthorized reconnaissance, privilege escalation, and persistent access within your cloud tenant.

sections.heading: Defense & Mitigation Strategies
sections.content: Enforce strict principle of least privilege, continuous auditing via CloudTrail/Config, and automated guardrails.
